fusions.name: Hurled Cocoon
fusions.desc: Hurls a packed cocoon that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Canopy Thrash
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Thrashes with every limb, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hand over Hand
fusions.desc: Strings a hauling line 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pummel the Stuck
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
